objective: Reusable kit for saves, remotes, rate limits and UI, written once with Roblox services injected so saves and remote validation run headless under Lune, plus a test that src/shared and src/kit stay pure.
acceptance_criteria: SaveStore: failed load never writes; fresh lock refused, stale lock taken; coalesced writes; re-apply on the stored record; in-flight changes kept; failed flush requeues; lost lock goes offline; finish releases (SaveStore.spec)
Router, Payload, RateLimit, Format, BuildStamp covered in Kit.spec, including NaN, oversize and extra-argument payloads and malformed spam being rate limited
Purity.spec fails if src/shared or src/kit uses a Roblox global
Roblox adapters Saves, Remotes and Ui build in every project; no existing game file changes
Decision 0011 records the save and remote contracts
verification: CI (Lune specs, Rojo builds, Selene); QA review of SaveStore against src/garden/Profiles.luau by a thread that did not write it
notes: Medium: the save engine will hold player data for every new game. No existing game uses it yet; Neon Spire is the first planned user. The Roblox adapters are not unit-tested and need a Studio check with DataStores on in the first game that uses them.
